notes: EBIT is modeled as GAAP operating income (“Operating income” line item) from Brown-Forman consolidated statements. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/sites/default/files/team_resources/2025-06/BFB-2025%20IR_10K-POST_V8_ADA_REV2%20%281%29-compressed.pdf))

D&A equals the GAAP “Depreciation and amortization” line from the consolidated statement of cash flows; capex equals “Additions to property, plant, and equipment” (converted to absolute cash-outflow magnitudes). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/sites/default/files/team_resources/2025-06/BFB-2025%20IR_10K-POST_V8_ADA_REV2%20%281%29-compressed.pdf))

NWC is computed using: NWC = (Total current assets − cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − short-term debt), where short-term debt = short-term borrowings + current portion of long-term debt. This is a modeling convention and may not match any company-specific NWC definition. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/14693/000001469324000086/bfb-20240430.htm))

NOL balance is proxied using the “loss and credit carryforwards” gross amount disclosed in the deferred tax footnote (tax-effect carryforwards vs. explicit GAAP NOL balance may differ). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/sites/default/files/team_resources/2025-06/BFB-2025%20IR_10K-POST_V8_ADA_REV2%20%281%29-compressed.pdf))

Tax rate (0.20) and capex normalization in 2026 are anchored to fiscal 2026 updated outlook guidance (effective tax rate range ~19% to 21% and capex $110M-$120M). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))
Current_price is the latest available market snapshot (latest trade shown March 20, 2026) used as the March 21, 2026 as-of input.

Base-case forecast drivers beyond fiscal 2026 direction are analyst assumptions to form a coherent DCF bridge (not explicit company guidance). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

catalysts: Sustained execution of fiscal 2026 guidance through U.S. distribution evolution and the restructuring initiative’s cost takeout cadence. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Category and brand momentum (innovation and pricing/mix) translating into operating income that does not undershoot low-single-digit declines. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Potential operating leverage if gross margin and SG&A discipline hold while volume normalizes after portfolio transition effects. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))
company_overview: Global spirits manufacturer with a premium portfolio led by Jack Daniel's Family of Brands and Woodford Reserve, among others. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Operates in more than 170 countries with key markets including the United States, Mexico, Germany, Australia, and the United Kingdom. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Uses a fiscal year that ends April 30; the most recently reported full year is fiscal 2025 (ended April 30, 2025). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/sites/default/files/team_resources/2025-06/BFB-2025%20IR_10K-POST_V8_ADA_REV2%20%281%29-compressed.pdf))
current_context: Through nine months of fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 31, 2026), net sales were down 2% to $3.0B (flat on an organic basis) and operating income was flat at $905M (-3% on an organic basis). ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Operating margin improved to 30.0% (up 70 bps) while the company reiterated full-year guidance: organic net sales decline in the low-single digit range and organic operating income decline in the low-single digit range. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Fiscal 2026 outlook also implies capital expenditure of $110M-$120M and an updated effective tax rate range of approximately 19% to 21%. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Cash-flow support remains a key point: cash flows from operations increased to $709M and free cash flow to $628M, and the $400M share repurchase program was completed in December 2025. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))
investment_highlights: Base-case thesis assumes gradual EBIT margin normalization toward ~30% as restructuring and cost actions work through the cost base. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Near-term revenue is modeled with a sober low-single-digit decline consistent with reiterated organic guidance, while subsequent years recover modestly as innovation and distribution evolution take effect. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Capex is normalized toward the company’s fiscal 2026 plan (lower than FY2024), supporting free cash generation and limiting value leakage from overinvestment. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Working-capital intensity is allowed to decline modestly from FY2025 levels, reflecting continued disciplined inventory and supply-chain management. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))
key_risks: Sustained demand softness or promotional intensity leading to larger-than-modeled net sales declines. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Macro/geopolitical shocks (including tariffs/FX) and travel-retail variability impacting net sales and gross margin. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/article/brown-forman-reports-year-date-fiscal-2026-results-reaffirms-full-year-outlook-march-4-2026))

Restructuring execution risk (cost overruns, longer restructuring timelines, and impairment risk) that delays margin recovery. ([brown-forman.com](https://www.brown-forman.com/sites/default/files/team_resources/2025-06/BFB-2025%20IR_10K-POST_V8_ADA_REV2%20%281%29-compressed.pdf))
